description: The record/object surfaces and property editing as shared primitives: one record header, one property row, one add-property affordance, one hidden-properties group, one type picker and one exported inline-editor primitive per column type — consumed by the record sheet, the table record peek, the properties panel, the board-card properties panel, the property modals and every cell editor, with the Anytype object-page and relation-panel behaviours designed against the capture sweep and formulas/rollups/calculations staying ours
